name: Run NewEra Verification Review
description: Chạy review kiểm chứng khi người dùng kích hoạt thủ công.

then.prompt: Before reviewing the selected M or Phase, run `python3 scripts/newera_validate.py --state .newera/project-state.json`. If the checkpoint is imminent, also run the `--strict` form. Then read the relevant test-plan, execute applicable checks, create evidence, update traceability and report blockers. A gate FAIL must be fixed, recorded or moved to BLOCKED/residual. Do not convert verification into acceptance.
